title: 第17章 通天涯有女相约第18章 玉笛颤得印衍天
slug: 我在大虞当杀手那些年
content_zh:
这一日，
云落城开庆功宴，守将耿涛犒赏三军，论功行赏。
齐安与刘凡也有功劳。
齐安被耿涛提拔为百夫长，连升两级。
刘凡调入神机营，任职校尉，有教导射术之职。
同日，
云落城在飞沙镇招兵，只招从过军的，近二十人被带走。
其中有个大胡子是例外。
人群中他一眼就被挑中，兴奋的他直接给招兵的跪下。
他不知道自己为什么会被选中，只觉得是自己时来运转。
虽说进入军中会有战死的风险，但比起飞沙镇这个等死的囚笼，要好上一万倍。
况且，
他日若是立了功，未尝不能翻身！
……
贺兰部落覆灭。
或许还有一些漏网之鱼虾。
但这世界的法则就是这样，大鱼吃小鱼，小鱼吃虾米。
草原上的大鱼，会把贺兰部落那些小鱼小虾，吃得连渣都不剩。
而随着贺兰部落覆灭的消息传开，整个草原都震动了。
以为大虞是要与草原开战，弄的人心惶惶。

好在镇北军在灭掉贺兰部落后，便是立即撤回了云落城，这让草原人大大的松了口气。
倒也有个部落，扬言要与大虞开战，为贺兰部落报仇。
那就是慕容部落。
起初大家还觉得慕容部落对待兄弟部落很仗义。
可当听说慕容部落的三王子也死在了贺兰部落，也就没人搭理了。
原因很简单，大虞皇朝虽说内部争斗不断，但实力仍不可小觑。
贸然对大虞用兵，大虞必定重新凝聚，继而一致对外。
总之一句话，不是不打，是时机未到。
破船还有三千钉，更何况立国一千多年的偌大皇朝呢。
慕容部落想找大虞复仇，可又担心出兵大虞会被其他部落偷袭。
如此，慕容部落只能将仇恨压下。
这些仇恨不会被遗忘，会在日后的某一天爆发。
届时，新帐旧帐便要一起清算，
……
昨日里趟风冒雪来到塞北。
今日里下江南桃杏争春。
裴礼跟着一只商队，从凉州一路南下。
content_en:
On this day,
A celebration banquet was held in Yunluo City, and the guard Geng Tao rewarded the three armies and rewarded them based on their merits.
Qi An and Liu Fan also contributed.
Qi'an was promoted to centurion by Geng Tao and was promoted two levels in a row.
Liu Fan was transferred to the Shenji Camp and served as a school captain, with the job of teaching archery.
On the same day,
Yunluo City recruited troops in Feisha Town, and only recruited those who had served in the army. Nearly twenty people were taken away.
One exception is the bearded man.
He was picked out at a glance from the crowd, and he was so excited that he knelt down directly to the recruiter.
He didn't know why he was chosen, he just thought it was his luck.
Although there is a risk of death in battle if you join the army, it is ten thousand times better than waiting to die in a prison in Feisha Town.
Moreover,
If he succeeds in doing something good in the future, he might not be able to stand up!
…
The Helan tribe was destroyed.
Maybe there are still some fish and shrimps that have slipped through the net.
But this is the law of the world: big fish eat small fish, and small fish eat shrimps.
The big fish on the grassland will eat up the small fish and shrimps of the Helan tribe until there is no residue left.
And as the news of the destruction of the Helan tribe spread, the entire grassland was shaken.
People thought that Dayu was going to start a war with the grassland, which made people panic.
Fortunately, the Zhenbei Army immediately withdrew to Yunluo City after annihilating the Helan tribe, which made the grassland people heave a sigh of relief.
There was also a tribe that threatened to go to war with Dayu to avenge the Helan tribe.
That is the Murong tribe.
At first, everyone thought that the Murong tribe treated their brother tribes very righteously.
But when they heard that the third prince of the Murong tribe had also died in the Helan tribe, no one paid any attention to him.
The reason is very simple. Although the Dayu Dynasty is constantly fighting internally, its strength cannot be underestimated.
If you rashly use troops against Dayu, Dayu will surely reunite and then attack the outside world in unison.
In short, it's not that we won't fight, it's that the time has not come yet.
There are still three thousand nails in the broken ship, not to mention the huge dynasty that has been in existence for more than a thousand years.
The Murong tribe wanted to seek revenge against Dayu, but they were worried that Dayu would be attacked by other tribes if they sent troops.
In this way, the Murong tribe could only suppress their hatred.
These hatreds will not be forgotten and will explode one day in the future.
At that time, the new and old accounts will be settled together.
…
Yesterday we came to Saibei through wind and snow.
Today, I went down to the south of the Yangtze River to see peaches and apricots competing for spring.
Pei Li followed a caravan all the way south from Liangzhou.
